headline: Argentine President Milei Outlines Tax Cuts and Economic Deregulation Plans
summary: President Javier Milei detailed plans for his second-term agenda in Argentina, focusing on tax reductions, returning funds to taxpayers, boosting mineral and agricultural exports, and deepening economic deregulation.
why: Argentina is seeking economic stabilization, lower inflation, and foreign investment to service international sovereign debt commitments.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Tax cuts and trade opening aim to stimulate private capital investment and commodity export expansion.
